description: Artifact hash, manifest hash, signed publisher and registry attestations and a transparency-log inclusion proof for one capability. Use when: you want to check that a package is the one the registry published and signed. Not for: benchmark results (get_benchmark) or the card (get_capability). Input: a capability id, ak:// URI or slug. Output: ak.provenance.v1 with the hashes, the attestations, an RFC 9162 inclusion proof against the signed tree head, the trust checks and the keys URL.

capability.description: Capability id (ak:publisher:name or ak:publisher:name:x.y.z), ak:// URI or slug.

name: get_provenance
title: Get provenance
